[C] FloatingBox variants
=========================================================
FloatingBox
  +-- FloatingPane -> stored in DisplayState.nodes
  |     |
  |     +-- selection: captured sourceBoxId/contentId,
  |     |     ASCII, revision?, rect, selectedIds
  |     |     displayMode: stacked | chained
  |     +-- projection: title, revision/projection IDs?
  |     |     content: call-tree | compaction
  |     |              source-code | code-panel
  |     +-- conversation: thread, draft, canvasAnchor
  |     |     presentation: compact | floating | docked
  |     +-- detail: title, ascii, sectionId?
  |
  +-- arrow: drawEdge(document.edges) -> derived only

DisplayNodeBase
  id, childIds, expansion, expandedGeometry?
  position {x,y}, bounds {width,height}: CSS pixels
  coordinateSpace: canvas | viewport
  geometryPolicy: automatic/manual + content/fixed
       |
       +-> add/remove ownership tree; recursive removal
       +-> collapse saves geometry; expand restores it
SelectionState owns membership; pane captures context.
Sources: displayModel.ts, canvasDisplayNode.ts
